description: Les bornes de recharge de véhicules éléctriques (IRVE) du département de Meurthe-et-Moselle (54) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by catalogue.infogeo54.fr. Charging stations for electric vehicles or Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure (IRVE) in the department of Meurthe-et-Moselle. context: The law on the energy transition for green growth places territories at the heart of climate-air-energy action. This law set the framework within which the "Positive Energy Territories for Green Growth" scheme is developed. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Electric vehicle charging stations (IRVE) of the department of Meurthe-et-Moselle (54)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include véhicules, données ouvertes, bornes, recharge, irve, életriques. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
